content: Photocoagulation and anti-VEGF therapy have been shown to be effective in the management of diabetic macular edema. Anti-VEGF injections not only improve visual acuity but also reduce the necessity for laser treatments. Panretinal photocoagulation is a proven method for preventing severe vision loss in patients with high-risk proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR). However, anti-VEGF therapy may provide additional advantages for patients who prefer or require a less invasive treatment approach.
